name: Shelina Visram
displayName: Dr Shelina Visram, PhD, MPH, FFPH
researchKeywords: marginalised populations, place-based public health, co-production, knowledge mobilisation
bio: Dr Shelina Visram, PhD, MPH, FFPH is a Senior Lecturer in Public Health and a member of Newcastle University's Public Health and Health Inequalities research theme. She is the Population Health Sciences Institute's Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Lead and a member of its Executive Committee.
researchFocus: Shelina studies the lived experiences of marginalised, vulnerable and under-represented populations; asset- and place-based approaches to improving health; lay involvement in public health; and complex policy and system-level interventions. Her work uses co-production and knowledge mobilisation to connect research with policy and practice.
